chunks: Hisham, Hafs, and Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام that he said:
Are those who look at the backs of women secure from being afflicted with that in their own women?

key_terms.أَدْبَارِ النِّسَاءِ: the backs or rear aspect of women; a reference to lustful or improper looking
key_terms.نِسَائِهِمْ: their own women, meaning the women of their household
key_terms.يَنْظُرُونَ: they look; here it means directing one's gaze in an improper way
key_terms.يُبْتَلَوْا: to be afflicted or tested with the like of it

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about looking at women indecently?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against indecent looking at women by reminding a person that wrongful conduct may return to affect his own household. It teaches moral restraint, modesty, and awareness of the social consequences of violating proper boundaries.
